name: Cactus Confusion
author: GregoryLane
description: Made using the Creator Kit: Beginner Code tutorial (https://learn.unity.com/project/creator-kit-beginner-code), and following the Cactus Mod (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=a6lpcR47sDE). Point to click and navigate this wild west town! In the lawless west one question remains - will you search the lands in riches for yourself, or will you be loyal to your cactus brethren?
